premises.title: Drop
premises.opening_image: a ball hangs at the top of an empty frame
premises.central_action: the ball falls and squashes on contact
premises.complication: it stretches as it falls fast

premises.title: Roll
premises.opening_image: a cube sits on a slope beside a puddle
premises.audience_hook: is the cube going to tip into the puddle?
premises.central_action: the cube tumbles edge over edge down the slope
premises.complication: a gust pushes it back uphill
premises.payoff: it lands balanced on one corner

premises.title: Grow
premises.opening_image: a seed lies in dark soil under a cracked pot
premises.central_action: a shoot spirals upward through the crack
premises.payoff: a flower opens beside the stone

rationale: the smallest complete cause and effect for an engine smoke test
